# Atlas CLI — concept pack (small)

> Source-anchored research for Atlas CLI. Run status: COMPLETED.

<!-- generated by llms-concept-abstractor v1.4.1 · generated 2026-10-30 · budgeted to ≈8000 tokens; the full catalogue is llms-full.txt -->

## Problems, failure modes and limitations

- [statement] The CLI security policy says credentials use native OS keyrings when available, but fall back to plaintext config.toml when keyring services are unavailable. The CLI emits a warning for this fallback. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-30) — https://github.com/mongodb/mongodb-atlas-cli/security
- [statement] In atlas-github-action issue 30, a user reported HttpError: Bad credentials while a helper action fetched a release tag from the GitHub API, before Atlas CLI installation. This report supports checking GitHub workflow credentials at that stage; it does not demonstrate an Atlas database authentication failure or an Atlas CLI runtime defect. (low confidence) — https://github.com/mongodb/atlas-github-action/issues/30

## Comparisons and alternatives

- [statement] Homebrew declares installation conflicts with the atlas and nim formulae because they also install an atlas executable. Check command identity when an installed atlas command behaves unlike MongoDB Atlas CLI. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://formulae.brew.sh/formula/mongodb-atlas-cli
- [statement] Use service-account credentials or API keys for automation rather than an interactive user login. MongoDB documents MONGODB_ATLAS_CLIENT_ID and MONGODB_ATLAS_CLIENT_SECRET for service-account authentication; the official GitHub Action reads these environment variables from repository secrets. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-30) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/cli/current/atlas-cli-temporary-cluster.md · keywords: Atlas CLI · also: https://github.com/mongodb/atlas-github-action

## Facts and statements

- [statement] Atlas CLI manages MongoDB Atlas from the terminal. Developers can script resource provisioning and keep those scripts in version control. (high confidence) — https://github.com/mongodb/mongodb-atlas-cli · keywords: Atlas CLI · also: https://www.prisma.io/dataguide/mongodb/mongodb-atlas-setup
- [statement] The Homebrew installation command is brew install mongodb-atlas-cli; the formula installs the atlas executable and depends on mongosh. (medium confidence) — https://formulae.brew.sh/formula/mongodb-atlas-cli · keywords: Atlas CLI · also: https://github.com/mongodb/mongodb-atlas-cli
- [statement] For interactive authentication, run atlas auth login. Profiles preserve connection context; atlas config set, edit, describe, list, and rename manage those settings. (medium confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/manage-atlas-cli.md · keywords: Atlas CLI · also: https://www.prisma.io/dataguide/mongodb/mongodb-atlas-setup
- [statement] A repeatable provisioning sequence can create a cluster, wait with atlas clusters watch, configure network access, create an application database user with a restricted role and cluster scope, and retrieve its connection string. Prisma demonstrates this sequence separately from one-command sandbox setup. (low confidence) — https://www.prisma.io/dataguide/mongodb/mongodb-atlas-setup
- [statement] Prisma distinguishes convenient atlas setup onboarding from application credentials: its setup-created atlasAdmin user should not be reused by an application; its staged example creates a readWrite@appdb user scoped to one cluster. (low confidence) — https://www.prisma.io/dataguide/mongodb/mongodb-atlas-setup
- [statement] The Atlas Local CLI repository exposes local management as atlas local commands through a first-class Atlas CLI plugin installed automatically on first invocation. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-30) — https://github.com/mongodb/atlas-local-cli
- [statement] Atlas CLI 1.52.0 release notes, dated 2026-02-05, deprecate the older deployment command family and add atlas local; Prisma describes atlas local as the replacement for atlas deployments. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-02-05) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/cli/current/atlas-cli-changelog.md · keywords: Atlas CLI · also: https://www.prisma.io/dataguide/mongodb/mongodb-atlas-setup, https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/cli/current/atlas-cli-deploy-local.md
- [statement] The local development path runs a containerized single-node replica set with MongoDB Search and Vector Search; Prisma illustrates atlas local setup and atlas local connect for tests and offline work. (low confidence) — https://www.prisma.io/dataguide/mongodb/mongodb-atlas-setup
- [statement] Migrating from MongoDB CLI preserves profiles and saved API keys by populating config.toml from mongocli.toml; automation must replace mongocli atlas invocations and references to the old configuration file. (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/cli/current/migrate-to-atlas-cli.md
- [statement] The migration guide permits either MongoDB CLI or Atlas CLI environment-variable families, but explicitly prohibits using both families together. (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/cli/current/migrate-to-atlas-cli.md
- [statement] In issue 1642, opened in January 2023 against Atlas CLI 1.4.0, quickstart failed without a projectId. A maintainer explained that the command needed project context from a flag, configuration, or environment; this historical thread does not establish a present-version regression. (low confidence) — https://github.com/mongodb/mongodb-atlas-cli/issues/1642
- [statement] Homebrew installs Atlas CLI with brew install mongodb-atlas-cli; the executable is named atlas. MongoDB also distributes prebuilt binaries that can run without a privileged global installation. (high confidence) — https://github.com/mongodb/mongodb-atlas-cli · keywords: Atlas CLI · also: https://formulae.brew.sh/formula/mongodb-atlas-cli
- [statement] For interactive access, atlas auth login uses browser authorization with a one-time code. A saved profile can hold the default organization and project; explicit --orgId and --projectId flags select those contexts per command. (high confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/cli/current/connect-atlas-cli.md · keywords: Atlas CLI · also: https://www.prisma.io/dataguide/mongodb/mongodb-atlas-setup
- [statement] Atlas setup can create a sandbox cluster and database user and connect through mongosh. Its --currentIp option adds the executing machine to the project access list; --skipSampleData avoids loading sample datasets. (high confidence) — https://www.prisma.io/dataguide/mongodb/mongodb-atlas-setup · keywords: Atlas CLI · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/cli/current/atlas-cli-temporary-cluster.md
- [statement] Temporary automation environments need explicit teardown. MongoDB documents deleting the cluster before deleting its project; CANNOT_CLOSE_GROUP_ACTIVE_ATLAS_CLUSTERS means the cluster has not finished shutting down, so project deletion must wait. Paid test clusters continue incurring charges until deleted. (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/cli/current/atlas-cli-temporary-cluster.md
- [statement] Atlas CLI supports container-backed local development with atlas local setup: a single-node replica set with MongoDB Search and Vector Search. The documented prerequisites include Docker, with Podman also supported on RHEL; this enables a local test workflow alongside cloud provisioning. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/cli/current/atlas-cli-deploy-local.md · keywords: Atlas CLI · also: https://www.prisma.io/dataguide/mongodb/mongodb-atlas-setup
- [statement] The official mongodb/atlas-github-action installs Atlas CLI for workflow commands. Its README limits support to Linux runners, allows selecting a CLI version with the version input, and states that only the latest CLI version is officially supported. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-30) — https://github.com/mongodb/atlas-github-action
